patients.name: Elena Vance
patients.chiefComplaint: Hypotension, acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, rigors

imaging.title: CT Thorax w/o IV Contrast (Pulmonary Parenchyma)
findings: Dense right lower lobe alveolar consolidation with air bronchograms.
Trace right-sided parapneumonic pleural effusion (approx. 120 mL).
Main pulmonary artery diameter 28 mm; no pericardial effusion.
imaging.impression: Right lower lobe multifocal pneumonia; mild dependent effusion.

imaging.title: Portable AP Chest Radiograph
findings: Patchy retrocardiac and right basilar opacity compared to 06:00 baseline.
Endotracheal/central line tip positions unremarkable; no pneumothorax.
imaging.impression: Interval progression of right basilar infiltrate.

imaging.title: Bedside Telemetry — Lead II Continuous Strip
findings: Sinus tachycardia at 112 bpm; normal axis.
No acute ST-segment elevation; QTc 448 ms.
imaging.impression: Sinus tachycardia without acute ischemic ST changes.

supportingEvidence: Procalcitonin elevated to 8.42 ng/mL with WBC 18.6 K/µL
Arterial lactate 4.0 mmol/L despite initial 30 mL/kg crystalloid bolus
Chest CT demonstrates dense RLL consolidation with air bronchograms
differentials.recommendedWorkup: Repeat lactate q2h, Vancomycin + Aztreonam (PCN allergy)

supportingEvidence: D-Dimer elevated at 940 ng/mL; persistent hypoxemia (SpO2 91%)
Sinus tachycardia 112 bpm with borderline hypotension
contradictingFactors: D-Dimer elevation frequently secondary to acute sepsis/inflammation
Clear lobar infectious consolidation and high fever 39.0 °C
differentials.recommendedWorkup: Bedside Echo RV strain assessment prior to contrast CTA

contradictingFactors: Febrile curve 39.0 °C and focal unilateral consolidation
differentials.recommendedWorkup: No further ischemic workup unless Troponin rises

alerts.title: Sepsis-3 Lactate Clearance Threshold
alerts.detail: Lactate remains >= 4.0 mmol/L after initial fluid resuscitation; evaluate vasopressor titration to MAP >= 65 mmHg.

alerts.title: Renal Adjustment Required (eGFR 41 mL/min)
alerts.detail: Creatinine rose +0.62 mg/dL (AKI Stage 1). Adjust Vancomycin trough dosing and avoid iodinated contrast without pre-hydration.

notes.author: Dr. Aris Thorne
notes.text: Patient remains vasodilated with MAP 62–65 mmHg on Norepinephrine 0.12 mcg/kg/min. Added Aztreonam + Vancomycin due to severe Penicillin allergy. Monitoring urine output hourly.

patients.chiefComplaint: Crushing substernal chest pain radiating to left jaw, diaphoresis

imaging.title: Anterior Leads V1–V4 Telemetry Tracing
findings: 3.5 mm convex ST-segment elevation in V2–V4 with reciprocal inferior depression.
Occasional unifocal PVCs; sinus rate 106 bpm.
imaging.impression: Acute Anterior Wall ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (LAD Territory).

imaging.title: CT Thoracic Aorta Rule-Out Protocol
findings: Normal ascending and descending thoracic aortic caliber; no intimal flap.

supportingEvidence: 3.5 mm ST elevation in V2–V4 with reciprocal II, III, aVF depression
Troponin-I rising rapidly from 3.42 to 14.82 ng/mL
differentials.recommendedWorkup: Emergent PCI, Dual Antiplatelet + Heparin Infusion

contradictingFactors: CT Thorax ruled out intimal flap / intramural hematoma

alerts.title: Cath Lab Door-to-Balloon Window
alerts.detail: Confirmed Anterior STEMI with rising Troponin-I (14.82 ng/mL). Ensure Heparin bolus & P2Y12 loading complete prior to transfer.

notes.author: Dr. E. Rostova
notes.text: CT ruled out aortic dissection. Cath lab team mobilized for emergent LAD PCI. Repleting K+ 3.4 mEq/L to minimize arrhythmia risk.
